low_power_modes_summary.sleep_mode: CAN device set into sleep mode without internal activity and with disconnected bus drivers.
low_power_modes_summary.wake_up: Finished by any bus activity or by internal conditions; transfer layer waits for oscillator stabilization + 11 consecutive recessive bits before going on-bus.
low_power_modes_summary.wake_up_message_id: 'rrr rrrd rrrr' (lowest-possible identifier; loses arbitration to everything else).

fields.notes: Power-domain partitioning is deferred to SoC + transceiver IP. The protocol-defined sleep/wake state machine is the only power feature in CAN 2.0.
